target: AArch64 QEMU virt with PCI VirtIO sound and WAV backend
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=/tmp/zeal-ohgreat-final.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-ohgreat
checks: Launched the unchanged stock /Demo/Sound/OhGreat.ZC from the graphical terminal; its first lyric line appeared.
The stock Play loop generated 111132 stereo frames at 44.1 kHz (2.52 s of captured PCM); 218736 samples were nonzero and peak amplitude was 7000.
Ctrl-Alt-C exited the song and returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Verifies OhGreat runtime playback through the QEMU VirtIO sound device and terminal recovery. It does not establish audible live UTM or Raspberry Pi sound output.
